subject: Co-build ISV integration: GTM onboarding, rev-share & lead registration
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@stellarsw.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@stellarsw.com
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:07:00 +0000
Subject: Potential co-build + revenue share for native connector

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. Stellar Software is excited about building a native connector into Redwood to offer low-latency inference directly to our enterprise customers.

Quick summary of asks from our side:
- Confirm a starter commercial model (referral vs. rev-share vs. resale) for the first 12 months.
- A simple lead registration mechanism so customer introductions we bring are protected.
- A lightweight SOW/delivery cadence for a co-developed feature (we've attached a draft SOW and a one-page roadmap).

Goals: launch an integration proof-of-concept in Q1 and have a co-marketed pilot with 2 customers by Q2.

Could you loop in your GTM/partnership ops folks so we can align on margins and registration windows?

Attachments: Stellar_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW stub), integration-roadmap.xlsx (roadmap)

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Stellar Software
lena@stellarsw.com | +1 415-555-0198

Stellar Software | Bring models to the edge
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@stellarsw.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Potential co-build + revenue share for native connector

Lena —

Really appreciate the clear brief and the SOW stub. I'm keen to get this moving. High-level thoughts:

1) Commercial path: for a co-built native integration we typically start with a 70/30 revenue-share in favor of the product owner for the first 12 months (70% Stellar / 30% Redwood) while we share co-marketing credits. After 12 months we re-evaluate based on usage and leads converted.

2) Lead registration: we need a lightweight registration window (90 days) with proof of introduction (email chain or CRM activity). We can automate via HubSpot registration records; Marissa will own the operational flow.

3) GTM & onboarding: recommend a two-track plan — technical pilot (PM/Eng) + commercial pilot (sales/CS). Camila will coordinate enablement and co-marketing assets.

Can Marissa outline the exact registration workflow and the tiers (pilot, early-access, general availability)? Also copying Camila to start a calendar invite for a 60-min alignment next week.

I will ask Legal to push a short-form agreement with reseller/rev-share terms (no surprises) — we typically use a template that supports referral then rev-share conversion.

Cheers,
Vivek
VP Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Potential co-build + revenue share for native connector — proposed ops playbook

Hi all — quick ops note and proposed structure (keeping things simple for the pilot):

1) Commercial tiers (pilot -> GA):
   - Pilot (0–6 months): 80/20 rev-share to Stellar (80% to Stellar, 20% to Redwood) to incent early adoption and co-sell.
   - Early-access (6–12 months): 75/25 split.
   - GA (post 12 months): baseline 70/30 with performance kicker (usage over X tokens adds +5% to Stellar).

2) Lead registration (practical flow):
   - Registration window: 90 days from first intro.
   - Evidence: email chain + HubSpot record link.
   - Protect: registered lead must have a first qualified meeting within 45 days or registration expires (we can allow one 30-day auto-extension upon request).
   - Conflict resolution: if both parties claim, we default to earliest HubSpot timestamp and require manual review.

3) Payment & invoicing cadence:
   - Redwood invoices monthly; we provide usage report + line items for shared revenue.
   - Payment terms: Net 30.

4) Legal and docs:
   - I will share a short addendum template for rev-share + lead registration (DocuSign link to follow).

5) Next steps for next week:
   - 60-min alignment call (tech + GTM) — propose Tue 2026-11-09 16:00 PT / Wed 2026-11-10 00:00 UTC.
   - Marissa will create a HubSpot registration form and share the link.

If that looks good, I'll draft the addendum and Camila can start the enablement checklist (docs, demo tenant access, co-branded one-pager).

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
